payload.instructions: Speak standard Tokyo Japanese. Read only the supplied word once, naturally and clearly. The word has four morae: a, ki, ra, ka. Use Tokyo pitch accent type 2 (nakadaka): a is low, ki is high, then drop immediately after ki; ra and ka are low. The pitch pattern is low-high-low-low. Maintain a smooth connected word without pauses between morae, without stress or exaggerated intonation. Do not add a particle, explanation, translation, or any other words.
